decks.notes: The deck focuses on controlling the board and hand with a wide range of removal and counterspells, while generating value through card advantage and recursion. It aims to outvalue opponents with a mix of powerful threats and versatile spells, utilizing cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value and strategic options in longer games. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the deck's multicolor requirements and maximize consistency.

This aggro deck focuses on utilizing artifacts and sacrificing them for value, with The Underworld Cookbook as a key card for generating advantage. It also includes aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Voldaren Epicure to put pressure on the opponent. The deck also features burn spells like Galvanic Blast and Shrapnel Blast to finish off opponents quickly. The Urza's Saga land helps to tutor for key artifacts while Mishra's Factory provides additional creature threats. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creature aggression and burn spells.

The deck focuses on controlling the board by utilizing powerful Elemental creatures and spells to maintain dominance. It aims to disrupt opponents with counterspells and removal while ramping up mana with cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Risen Reef. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value through flickering creatures and permanents. The deck also includes a mix of utility lands and versatile cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six to provide flexibility and consistency in its control strategy.

The deck focuses on cycling through creatures, disrupting the opponent with counterspells, and eventually cascading into Living End to bring back all the cycled creatures and clearing the opponent's board. It utilizes cards like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent to cascade into Living End efficiently, while also utilizing creatures like Grief and Curator of Mysteries to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to control the board early game and then overwhelm the opponent with a massive board presence once Living End is cast.

The deck focuses on assembling and equipping powerful equipment like Colossus Hammer onto creatures quickly to deal large amounts of damage in a short amount of time. It uses cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Puresteel Paladin to search for and equip the necessary pieces, while also including protection cards like Giver of Runes and Esper Sentinel to ensure the combo goes off smoothly. The inclusion of Urza's Saga provides additional value by tutoring for key artifacts, making the deck versatile and resilient against disruption.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays that disrupt the opponent's hand while applying pressure on the board. It aims to control the game using efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt, Fatal Push, and Terminate, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek. The creatures in the deck, such as Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer, provide additional threats and card advantage. Liliana of the Veil helps to control the board and disrupt the opponent further. Overall, this deck seeks to win quickly through a combination of removal, disruption, and aggressive creatures.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays using Cascade mechanics to continuously put pressure on the opponent. By cascading into powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls or Fury, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly. The inclusion of disruptive cards like Force of Negation and Mystical Dispute helps protect the deck's game plan while also disrupting the opponent's strategy. The mana base is built to support the deck's colors and enable early plays, while cards like Gemstone Caverns and Boseiju, Who Endures provide additional utility. Ultimately, the goal is to execute a fast and explosive game plan that outpaces the opponent.

The key concept of this deck is to aggressively play efficient threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Counterspell and disruption spells like Unholy Heat. The deck aims to control the board in the early game and pressure the opponent with hard-hitting creatures like Murktide Regent. The deck also utilizes card draw and selection spells like Expressive Iteration to maintain card advantage and find the right answers to deal with the opponent's threats. The mana base is optimized for consistency and flexibility in casting spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful Elementals alongside control elements to outvalue and out tempo the opponent. By generating card advantage and mana efficiency with cards like Risen Reef and Omnath, Locus of Creation, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with removal spells like Prismatic Ending and Lightning Bolt, the deck aims to control the board and win through incremental advantages. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value and synergy with the deck's strategy of controlling the game and overwhelming the opponent with card advantage.

The deck focuses on controlling the board through a combination of counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It utilizes Elementals as the main creature type, with cards like Risen Reef and Omnath, Locus of Creation providing value and tempo. Yorion, Sky Nomad serves as a companion to provide additional value with the flicker effect. The mana base is designed to support multiple colors and enable flexibility in casting spells. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents through efficient control and powerful Elemental synergy.

This deck focuses on filling the graveyard with cards like Tarmogoyf and Dauthi Voidwalker to pump up their power and disrupt the opponent's strategy through discard spells like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek. Grist, the Hunger Tide and Liliana of the Veil provide additional value by creating tokens and controlling the board. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Assassin's Trophy to deal with threats. The mana base allows for consistent casting of spells and includes utility lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Hive of the Eye Tyrant.

The deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures that can be searched for and deployed using various combo pieces such as Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution. By utilizing creatures with powerful abilities like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician, the deck aims to generate value and disruption while pressuring the opponent. The deck also includes combo pieces like Blood Artist and Geralf's Messenger to close out games quickly. With a mix of mana ramp, recursion, and disruptive creatures, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a versatile and resilient game plan.

This Dredge deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with cards using cards like Cathartic Reunion and Thrilling Discovery, then using the Dredge mechanic to bring back creatures like Stinkweed Imp and Golgari Thug. By milling and dredging cards, the deck aims to get out creatures like Prized Amalgam and Silversmote Ghoul to create a strong board presence. Additionally, cards like Creeping Chill and Ox of Agonas provide additional value and reach for the deck, making it a powerful combo-based strategy in Modern 1 vs 1 gameplay.

This deck focuses on a fast and aggressive playstyle with a mix of disruption and pressure. By utilizing powerful threats like Tarmogoyf, Kroxa, and Seasoned Pyromancer, supported by removal spells like Fatal Push and Lightning Bolt, the deck aims to apply early pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with discard spells like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize. The inclusion of planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil and Wrenn and Six provides additional value and versatility, making it difficult for opponents to stabilize and come back from behind.

The deck focuses on cycling cards to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures, then casting Living End to wipe the board and bring all those creatures back to play. It includes disruption and control elements such as Force of Negation and Brazen Borrower to slow down opponents and protect the combo. The creatures in the deck also have powerful abilities that can further disrupt opponents or generate card advantage. This combination of graveyard manipulation, control, and powerful creature abilities makes for a fast and consistent win condition in Modern 1 vs 1 games.

The key concept of this Aggro-Affinity deck is to quickly and efficiently flood the board with cheap artifacts and creatures to overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Ornithopter, Frogmite, and Memnite alongside artifact lands like Darksteel Citadel and Treasure Vault, the deck aims to generate a large amount of mana and deploy powerful threats such as Myr Enforcer and Thought Monitor. The deck also includes various equipment like Cranial Plating and Nettlecyst to boost the power of its creatures and close out games quickly. The inclusion of utility cards like Relic of Progenitus and Shadowspear provide additional disruption and versatility.
